options.name: More original LOCO natural pallet scenes plus explicit source-only cue visibility annotation

options.action: Prospectively sample original TRAIN frames by capture groups; explicitly identify target instance and concrete cue, then annotate D/E/S/U/position uncertainty on those public images. Preserve missing cue as U, original folds and all failures. Independently review whether supplied target q falls within the cue support. No artificial cover is required for natural E examples.

native_order_statement: None of these publisher sources currently certifies correspondence to the application native8 order. YCB fixed mesh point/PCA octant order is an auxiliary convention; Pallox virtual cuboid is derived; LOCO has no keypoint order. Never choose per-image GT-best slot.
